method.sampling: same original pixel coordinates, every fourth pixel each axis; no registration, interpolation or crop
method.color: sRGB (EXIF ColorSpace=1, no ICC), OpenCV float RGB-to-Lab D65/2°, C=sqrt(a²+b²), hue=atan2(b,a); numerical CIELAB summaries, not ISP coefficients
method.percent: 100*(mean C target / mean C source - 1); not mean of pixel ratios
method.bins: based on Color 0; hue in degrees from +a toward +b; hue excludes C<10
method.limitations: one RAF and one camera rendering per level; JPEG quantization, other hidden settings, and scene dependence cannot be separated

spatial_tile_bootstrap.description: 96 spatial tiles, 3000 tile resamples, seed 296; conditional on this single image, not camera repeatability

geometry_control.interpretation: diagnostic global translation only; no warp applied

raf_embedded_preview.extraction: RAF header big-endian JPEG offset and length at 84 and 88; no file written
raf_embedded_preview.note: Unaligned independent embedded preview; crop, resolution and rendering may differ; not a Color setting control.
